query.text: 请帮我照看孩子写作业，如果他没在写或者分心了，请提醒他。
query.text_en: Please help me watch the child doing homework, and remind him if he is not writing or gets distracted.

annotation.text_zh: 该写作业了，先把手机收起来吧。
annotation.text_en: It's time for homework, so please put your phone away.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
